items.title: Coinbase Global (COIN) Loses Bid To Pause State Actions In Prediction Markets Case
items.summary: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS:COIN) failed to secure a pause on state enforcement actions from the U.S. Second Circuit in a prediction markets dispute. The ruling keeps state gambling regulators free to continue actions against Coinbase while courts assess prediction market contracts under federal and state law.
